_comment: CPUID family-model (decimal) -> events/<name>.json. Add a line per new generation after running make_event_json.py (Intel) or make_event_json_amd.py (AMD). '_ranges' is tried when there is no exact line. The exact AMD lines are the CPUID values the Broadcom Compatibility Guide lists for ESXi 8.0 and later (fetched 2026-11-12).

_ranges.note: AMD Zen 1: Family 17h models 00h-2Fh (kernel event list amdzen1)
AMD Zen 2: the other Family 17h models (amdzen2)
AMD Zen 4: the other Family 19h models (amdzen4). EPYC 9004 = model 11h and A0h, EPYC 8004 = model A0h
AMD Zen 5: Family 1Ah models 00h-2Fh, 40h-4Fh, 60h-7Fh (amdzen5). EPYC 9005 = model 02h and 11h
